snippet.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer (video game) - FULL GAME walkthrough | Longplay
snippet.description:
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer is an action adventure video game, base on the movie of the same name, developed by Visual Concepts and published by 2K in 2007. The story follows the Fantastic Four as they investigate the cosmic threat posed by the Silver Surfer. They encounter various villains, including Dr. Doom and other foes not seen in the movie.
